As Marqeta's Software Engineer II, you will deliver resilient and sustainable software projects from design to implementation and rollout. You will execute on defined projects to achieve team-level goals and own minor features in support of larger features. You will independently define the right solutions or use existing approaches to solve defined problems, consistently deliver high quality code, and contribute to test development.

We have three open roles right now within the following teams.

 - Ledger:
   
   - This team builds and evolves Marqeta's next-generation ledger platform — the system of record for every debit and credit that moves through our card issuing platform. They are responsible for the core money-movement infrastructure that powers Marqeta's business: enforcing balance and completeness guardrails on every transaction, supporting the account and currency structures our customers rely on, and ensuring our ledger meets industry standards required as we scale up-market. 

 - Card Issuing:
   
   - This team owns everything related to the user's card lifecycle, from the moment an account holder is created through card issuance, fulfillment, updates, and expiration. They build and operate the core payments platform services that millions of cards depend on, including Account Holders, Cards, and Account Lifecycle Management (ALM). They also own the services that keep card credentials current across card networks, along with the infrastructure that gets physical cards produced and delivered.

 - Tokenization:
   
   - This team owns virtual card issuance for 3 leading digital wallet providers: Apple Pay, Google Pay and Samsung Pay. The team owns and operates the services that enables our cardholders to provision cards into their digital wallets and make subsequent transactions


We work Flexible First https://www.marqeta.com/blog/2022/05/10/flexible-first. This role can be performed remotely anywhere within the province where you reside, whether that's Ontario, Canada or British Columbia, Canada. We'd love for you to join us!


These positions are for both an existing and not existing vacancy.

About Marqeta

Marqeta is on a mission to change the way money moves. We’re one of the earliest enablers of embedded finance, a market opportunity sized up in the trillions. Our card issuing platform provides unprecedented flexibility and control for companies to issue cards, authorize transactions, and manage payment operations in real time. Marqeta is powering the most well known brands in the new economy (Block, Cash App, Affirm, Instacart, Doordash, Uber, Walmart, etc). You don’t need to be a Payments expert to join the Marqeta Team, let us help you with that. This is the opportunity of a lifetime to work with innovators around the world and unlock equitable financial access for all.

Marqeta’s Values
